name: aid-graph-vendor-tracking
description: Version-tracking manifest for the graph view's vendored third-party bundles (d3-force's dependency chain plus PixiJS). Not installed, not built, not shipped as a dependency tree -- 'private' plus this manifest's exclusion from both published wrapper manifests (packages/npm, packages/pypi) is what feature-012 D6/G1 requires. The actual bytes this manifest tracks live one directory up the template tree, at canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-graph/vendor/<package>/, fetched by hand from each package's own upstream distribution -- never by `npm install` against this manifest. Dependabot watches this file (see .github/dependabot.yml) to notice a new upstream release; it does not and cannot re-vendor the bytes. See vendor-provisioning.md, beside this file, for the human follow-on procedure a version bump still requires.
